title: Caterpillar looks up and blinks
brief: A green handmade clay caterpillar hangs from a branch, raises its head a little, blinks once, and relaxes. Two-second fixed-camera shot.
invariants: Keep exact character identity, eye spacing, body segment count and clay material from the master.
Keep branch, tabletop, camera, composition and soft light fixed.
Keep the upper attachment gripping the same place on the branch.

references.role: Approved character and scene master; preserve identity and fixed set

frames.goal: Resting pose matching the master, eyes open, head relaxed.
Head just begins to lift; eyes open; upper attachment fixed.
Head a quarter of the way to a small upward tilt; slight body bend.
Head halfway to the small upward tilt; eyes looking slightly upward.
Head three quarters raised; preserve eye size and smile.
Head reaches a modest upward tilt; motion settles; eyes open.
Hold the raised-head pose; eyelids begin lowering.
Raised-head pose; eyelids halfway closed with eye positions fixed.
Raised-head pose; eyes gently fully closed at the blink midpoint.
Raised-head pose; eyelids halfway open again.
Raised-head pose; eyes fully open; blink complete.
Head begins easing down from the raised pose; eyes open.
Head halfway back to rest; body bend gradually relaxing.
Head nearly back at rest; smile and attachment unchanged.
Head reaches relaxed resting pose; eyes open.
Resting pose settles; original proportions and peaceful expression.
